subject: Animation
title: Australian Animation: From Dot to Happy Feet
description: A 60-second lesson on Australian Animation: From Dot to Happy Feet.

hook.text: Australia's animation history is small but includes a Best Picture Oscar winner: Happy Feet in 2006.

buildup.text: The NFB funded experimental animation for decades, building Canada's reputation as an artistic powerhouse.

discovery.text: Animal Logic, the Australian studio behind Happy Feet, became a major player in global CGI production.

twist.text: Despite its talent, Australia's small market means many animators leave for Hollywood or London studios.

climax.text: Australia punches above its weight in animation, with world-class studios and a growing talent pipeline.

punchline.text: A country of kangaroos made the world's most famous penguins.

quiz.question: What is Animal Logic's significance in Australian animation?
options: It created the first Australian animated TV show
It became a major global CGI studio after producing the Oscar-winning Happy Feet
It is Australia's oldest animation school
